failure_patterns.pattern: rule_ignored: Agents selected an associated work or relationship, an etymon, or an adjacent clue answer despite existing rules identifying the requested target.

rejected_edits.content: When choosing a name form, distinguish identity-bearing parts from generic type words supplied by the clue. Include conventional initials when the clue uses them or they are needed to disambiguate; otherwise do not add initials absent from the source-supported conventional form. Omit a generic label such as an entity type or location type when the clue supplies that type and the shorter name identifies the answer unambiguously.
rejected_edits.target: When choosing a name form, distinguish identity-bearing parts from generic type words supplied by the clue. Retain conventional initials that belong to a person's identifying name; omit a generic label such as an entity type or location type when the clue supplies that type and the shorter name identifies the answer unambiguously.

rejected_edits.content: Use the context-supported conventional answer form. For a person, use the conventional surname or shorter form when it is unambiguous; include given names only when needed. When a work, organization, or other named entity is requested as a whole, give its complete conventional name or title rather than only a familiar prefix. Do not add unrelated modifiers.
rejected_edits.target: Use a name form that uniquely identifies the entity: give the complete identifying name when needed, but a surname or shorter form is appropriate when it is unambiguous.
